spec_match.rationale: A real spellcheck-enabled editor beside a term list, with the one unavailable call (addWords) surfaced as exactly what it would have sent — never faked.

interactive.rationale: Term add/remove, the would-have-sent ledger and the editor all work (4 controls exercised, readouts changed).

edge_cases.rationale: Shows what cannot be observed afterwards (write-only design) and keeps the ledger honest about the absent call.

conformance.rationale: Suite honest-fails on this API-less build (recorded on probe-and-shape).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Controls exercised; ledger updated; console clean; both viewports clean.

design_system.rationale: Variables throughout; editor and list AA-safe.

accessibility.rationale: Editor labelled, term list operable by keyboard, aria-live ledger, visible focus.

summary: Verified on headless Chromium 153 (Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12) driven over CDP via a Playwright script — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud environment; desktop 1280×800 and mobile 360×740 DPR3 screenshots captured and inspected. The would-have-sent ledger is the right way to demo an absent write-only API.
